Whole minimum purchasable packs, spools and stock lengths are charged, including the mandatory two-battery purchase; reusable ground equipment is priced separately; nothing is owned; the check is total < 500.00 AUD (source b985cd4b, REQ-HARDWARE-BUDGET r4).

Human-named supplier starting points: rcdrone.top, jaycar.com.au, Temu, Taobao and the PyThrust catalogues (source c39dbd83). Other suppliers are used where their evidence was better; the reason is recorded per line.

currency_conversion.source: Reserve Bank of Australia, daily exchange rates (units of foreign currency per AUD)
currency_conversion.method: AUD per unit = 1 / (foreign units per AUD) on the base date; conservative = base x (1 + margin). The compute script recomputes these values from the observation.
limitations: RBA rates are indicative market observations, not retail card or bank conversion rates.
The 5 % adverse margin (exchange movement plus conversion spread) is a worker assumption awaiting human agreement; card fees, tax and shipping stay excluded under the human scope.

key_specifications.adapter_rings: Use LPAR06E adapter rings; includes one set of rings from LPAR06E
key_specifications.pythrust_data_id: APC_13x6.5E (mirror-image assumption; no separate EP table)

limitations: Aerodynamic equivalence of the EP part to the E data table is assumed, not measured.

Shaft-adapter compatibility for both rotation directions: both props share the 1/4 in bore and LPAR06E rings, so fit depends only on the unconfirmed collet-adapter thread. Nut loading depends on mounting. With the motors back-to-back (upper shaft up with the E prop; lower shaft down with the EP prop mounted front face toward its motor), both motors turn the same way relative to their own shafts, so both collet nuts see the same start-up and braking torque sense. With both motors facing up, the lower motor runs reversed and its nut sees the opposite sense. Either way use locking nuts or thread-locking compound and verify by a restrained run-up test.
